lines.en: I beat through the jungle leaves.
The hot wet air carries me.

lines.zh: 我绕过藤蔓，翅擦着叶片。
lines.en: I round a vine, wings brushing leaves.

lines.zh: 我在树冠下面飞，光很暗。
lines.en: I fly below the canopy where it's dark.
I climb along the trunk.

lines.zh: 我的翅上有橘褐的花纹。
lines.en: Orange-brown markings cover my wings.
I squeeze between broad leaves.
I fly low along the ferns.

lines.zh: 我在树与树之间走直线。
lines.en: I take a straight line between trees.
The damp slows me.
I go around a thorned vine.

lines.zh: 我飞过一片积水的洼地。
lines.en: I cross a pool of standing water.

lines.zh: 我鼓翅的声音在林中很闷。
lines.en: The sound of my wings is muffled here.
I climb toward the flowers above.

lines.zh: 我翅尖扫过叶面，溅起水。
lines.en: My wing tip stirs water off a leaf.

lines.zh: 我一夜要飞过整片林子。
lines.en: In one night I cross the whole wood.
I rest on the underside of a leaf, still.
Drops on the leaf shift.
I fold my wings into one shape.
I rest a while in the damp.
It's warmer here than outside.
I hear something climbing the tree.

lines.zh: 我的翅纹在暗处看不出。
lines.en: In the dark my markings disappear.
I keep still, like a dead leaf.
The blooms here open high up.

lines.zh: 我等着夜里最静的时候。
lines.en: I wait for the quietest part of the night.
There are other insects on the vines.
I don't bother them.

lines.zh: 你踩断了一根藤，我听见了。
lines.en: You broke a vine; I heard it.
I'm on the leaf above you.

lines.zh: 你抬头，正好看见我的翅。
lines.en: You look up and see my wings.

lines.zh: 丛林里没有风，你出汗了。
lines.en: There's no wind here; you're sweating.

lines.zh: 你把网举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: You raise the net; I see it.
I edge slowly toward the leaf's rim.
Come closer and I'll fly.
My wings open wide.
I'm waiting for you to lower your hand.
A piece of my wing is gone.
I veer and crash into the leaves.
I leave a trail of dust.
I land and roll over.
I crawl back onto a leaf.
The wing edge has curled.
I fly lower than before.
I rest on the trunk to recover.
I unfold my wings slowly.
That one hurt.

lines.zh: 那朵花的味道穿过湿气。
lines.en: That bloom's scent cuts through the damp.
I settle, feet first.

lines.zh: 这蜜很浓，比林子里的甜。
lines.en: This nectar is richer than the wood's.
My wings never stop.
Two sips and I lift off.
This one has already opened and gone.
I leave pollen behind.
Once I've fed I'll be gone.

lines.zh: 你这一碰，我歪着翻过去。
lines.en: That touch tips me over sideways.

lines.zh: 一片翅粉落进你的手里。
lines.en: A dusting of wing scales falls into your hand.

lines.zh: 我急忙往上飞，撞到叶子。
lines.en: I bolt upward and hit a leaf.
The knock drops me half a foot.
I circle back and land on your shoulder.
The vine leaves shake where I hit.
My wing edge is a little crumpled.
I settle on the trunk nearby.
I'm back on the underside of a leaf.
Her wings are a shade darker.
We settle side by side under a leaf.
She opens and closes her wings.
I follow her line of flight.
Our dust settles in the same place.
She stays on the leaf a long while.
She leaves; I stay.
The wood is hot tonight.
We share one canopy.
I reach my proboscis into the flower.
The nectar comes slowly here.
I can't reach the bottom.
I move to a lower bloom.

lines.zh: 我翅上的粉沾到了花上。
lines.en: The dust on my wings rubs onto the flower.
I stop only to rest.
Full now, my wings feel heavy.
I need the next open bloom.
The bloom is at the canopy's edge.
I fly that way.
There's sweetness in the damp.
I rise to leaf height.
A vine blocks me; I go around.
I see it through a gap in the leaves.
I fold both my wings in.
I edge closer, bit by bit.
I've picked where to land.
This is the spot.
I fly along that vine.
The sweetness grows nearer.
A web above; I drop lower.
I circle half way to find an angle.
My wings beat very softly.
There's still water on the leaf; I avoid it.
I hover before the bloom.
It's smaller than I expected.
I reach out with my feet to test.
Now I'm going down.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，翅扇到你脸上。
lines.en: I lunge and my wings fan your face.

lines.zh: 我的鳞粉进到你眼睛里。
lines.en: My wing dust gets in your eyes.
I bump your hand.
I beat my wings twice, hard.

lines.zh: 你伸手一抓，我掉了一半粉。
lines.en: You grab and half my dust is gone.
I fly wildly and hit a trunk.

lines.zh: 我落到你肩上，又飞起来。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and lift off.
I'm frantic; my wings go ragged.
I climb out of your reach.
I come out of a cocoon under a leaf.
My wings are just unfurled and still wet.
I hang at the leaf's edge and wait.
The wood is close and windless.
I try two beats.
I shift along the leaf's underside.
The wood has gone fully dark.
I catch the smell of flowers.
My wings have hardened.
I take off, climbing.
Fire touches me and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我掉进落叶里，爬不出来。
lines.en: I fall into the leaf litter and can't climb out.
Standing water pins me down.
The blast throws me against a tree.

lines.zh: 一根东西穿过了我的翅。
lines.en: Something pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 光一照，我的翅粉全没了。
lines.en: The light takes all my wing dust.

lines.zh: 找不到开的花，我撑不住。
lines.en: No open blooms, and I can't hold on.
The thunder presses me flat to the leaf.

lines.zh: 下面是无边的地方，我飘着。
lines.en: An endless space below; I drift.
